verdict.rationale: Brave's Web Search docs describe date-based filtering, including a 'Last 24 Hours' (`pd`) recency option. The docs also claim an index of billions of crawled pages that delivers fresh results, plus real-time news. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom start/end date ranges beyond preset recency windows, any stated index update frequency or crawl cadence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness.
